note:
⛔ SNG-511. THE COMPANION TEMPLATE — the one GM-generated content type with no template. Found by cataloguing what the model is asked to generate against what it is given to generate FROM: 13 of 14 categories had one; companions had nine hand-authored files and no shape.
⚠️ AND IT IS THE GAP I WAS AUTHORING BLIND INTO. I wrote Attended End with its own r1/r2/r3 ladder because I did not know `stages[]` was the progression — which is stated nowhere except in nine examples.
_derivedNotInvented: ⛔ MEASURED FROM ALL NINE, NOT DESIGNED. 16 fields appear; 14 on every one. `substrateAura` and `substrateNote` appear on 6 of 9 and are OPTIONAL. Stage counts are 2 (four companions) and 3 (five) — ⚠️ THREE IS THE FULL FORM and two is an unfinished one.

required.name: the companion's name as spoken
required.startingOption: ⚠️ boolean — may a player begin with this one
required.role: one line: what it is FOR at the table
required.persona: how it behaves, in its own register
required.voiceHints: how it speaks — used by the model directly
required.knowledge: ⛔ WHAT IT KNOWS THAT THE PLAYER DOES NOT — the rank ladder of any bondGrant is drawn from HERE
required.boundaries: ⛔ WHAT IT WILL NOT DO. Marrow: 'will not hasten an ending, ever, for any reason, including mercy.' ⚠️ THE BOUNDARIES BECOME THE BOND GRANT'S `bounds` — do not invent new ones
required.hooks: what it wants, and what it will ask of the player
required.bondGrants: ⛔ SEE §bondGrant — a REAL ABILITY, not a stub

stages._what: ⛔ STAGES ARE THE COMPANION'S RANK-UP MECHANISM AND THEY ADVANCE WITH BOND, NOT WITH POINTS. po/SPEC_SNG-200: 'stages are the spine'. ⚠️ CCode wired the mapping: bond 0-2 → stage 1, 3-9 → 2, 10 → 3.

shape.name: ⛔ THE COMPANION'S OWN NAME FOR WHAT IT HAS BECOME — not a tier label
shape.narrationHints: how it looks and behaves at this stage

stages._rule: ⚠️ AUTHOR THREE. Two is the unfinished form and four companions carry it.
stages._arc: ⛔ THE THREE STAGES ARE A RELATIONSHIP, NOT A POWER CURVE. Marrow: watches and does not interfere → tells you what it sees BEFORE YOU ASK → it did not leave.

bondGrant._what: ⛔ A BOND GRANT IS A FULL ABILITY AND MUST CARRY THE FULL ABILITY SCHEMA (SYSTEM_SPEC §32.6). ⚠️ ALL NINE ARE CURRENTLY STUBS carrying 9 fields and missing 14 — no `tree`, no `mechanic`, no `bounds`, no `plainly`, no `challengeTypes`.

extraFields.companionId: ⛔ REQUIRED — CCode: resolving the teacher from prose is a weak link
extraFields.progression: ⚠️ DO NOT AUTHOR — CCode reads the bond directly; the field is unread

bondGrant._ranksKeyToStages: ⛔ EACH RANK KEYS TO A `stage`, NOT TO A POINT SPEND. The rank NAME may differ from the stage name — the stage names what the COMPANION becomes, the rank names what it LENDS YOU. ⚠️ Attended End: Patient Gaze / Death's Certainty / Deathly Premonition against Marrow's The Attending Bird / The Told Truth / The One Who Stays.
bondGrant._cannotBeBought: ⛔ A point spent on a bond-controlled rank is a point burned. The engine refuses it.
bondGrant._pattern: content/packs/core/abilities/companion_taught.json — Attended End is the worked example.

_theEight: ⚠️ EIGHT BOND GRANTS STILL NEED AUTHORING TO THIS SHAPE: Motes' Vigil · Pack-Sense · The Old Procedure · Thin-Place Sense · The Kept Dark · Scholar's Margin · The Taking Root · A Second Pair of Hands. ⛔ EACH DRAWS ITS THREE TIERS FROM ITS OWN COMPANION'S `knowledge` AND `stages`, and its bounds from that companion's `boundaries`.
